note.title: Graphs, calculations and unit conversions
note.overview: Graph type follows data type; calculations require working, units and sensible treatment of anomalies.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for graphs, calculations and unit conversions.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: Categorical/discrete data: bar chart; continuous pairs: line or scatter graph.
IV on x-axis and DV on y-axis; label axes with units.
Percentage change = (new - original) / original x 100; g to mg, mg to micrograms and mm to micrometres multiply by 1000.
